description: An empty, dark ancient tower chamber with weathered gray stone pillars and a broad level stone floor; its elevation is unspecified. Cool moonlight enters through a broken upper opening, softly illuminating moss, hanging vines, and peripheral leaf silhouettes. Deep jade and muted sage washes, charcoal-gray stone, restrained silver light, and faint nocturnal mist maintain a shadowy but readable battle space. This is a descriptive room title, not a canonical place name.
title: Moonlit Stillness
